autostart.label: Start when signing in to Windows
autostart.hint: The agent will run in the tray after you sign in to your account.
autostart.readFailed: Could not read the startup setting.
autostart.saveFailed: Could not save the startup setting. Try again.

pairing.title: Pair the agent
pairing.hint: Create a pairing code in the Markiro cabinet and enter it here. Computer: {{hostname}}.

error.rejected: The code is not valid, has expired, or was already used. Create a new one in the cabinet.
error.unavailable: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.

certificates.label: Certificate for signing
certificates.empty: No GOST certificate with a private key was found. Check that CryptoPro is installed and the token is plugged in.
certificates.unavailable: Could not read the certificate store.
certificates.expiring: The certificate expires {{at}}. Issue a new one, or token refresh will stop working.
certificates.expired: The certificate expired {{at}}. Signing is not possible.

updates.title: Updates
updates.availableManual: Version {{version}} is available. Install it from the message above.
updates.checkFailed: Could not check for updates. Check the connection and try again.
updates.available: Version {{version}} is available. Updating restarts the agent.
updates.failed: Could not install the update. Check the connection and try again.

journal.title: Event journal
journal.hint: The latest 200 events are available in the app. Export includes the full saved journal.
journal.exportFailed: Could not export the journal. Choose another folder and try again.

localLessDurable.temporaryProfile: Windows signed you in with a temporary profile. The pairing will be lost when you sign out. Ask your IT team to fix the profile, then pair the agent.
localLessDurable.mandatoryProfile: This Windows profile is mandatory: changes, including the pairing, are discarded at sign-out. Ask your IT team for a regular profile on this computer.
localLessDurable.deleteRoamingCache: A domain policy deletes the local profile copy at sign-out, so the agent keeps its data in the roaming profile, which can follow you to other computers. Ask your IT team to review the policy for this computer.

storage.movePostponed: The agent data could not be moved out of the roaming profile yet. The agent keeps working and will retry at the next start.
storage.legacyCleanupPending: The old copy of the agent data in the roaming profile could not be removed yet. This computer no longer uses it; the agent will retry at the next start.

roamedCopy.sameAgent: A copy of this agent's pairing appeared in the roaming profile. If the agent also runs on another computer under this Windows account, revoke it in the cabinet and pair only the computer that holds the qualified certificate.
roamedCopy.otherAgent: Another pairing appeared in the roaming profile. This computer does not use it.

storage.credentialUnreadable: The saved pairing cannot be read by this Windows user on this computer. If you have just signed in to the domain, wait a minute; otherwise pair the agent again, then revoke the previous agent in the cabinet if no other computer should use it.
